subject: IAM evidence request & SOC 2 status — Vitality Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@vitality.health>, Elena Park <elena.park@vitality.health>
Cc: security@vitality.health
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: IAM evidence & SOC 2 status — next steps

Hi Jordan / Elena,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Per our discovery, you had a few specific security/compliance asks before procurement can move forward. I wanted to summarize next steps and the specific IAM evidence Vitality requested so we can keep momentum: 

Ask list (from call):
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
- SSO/SAML configuration details and metadata
- SCIM provisioning API spec and whether we support SCIM v2
- RBAC / admin controls documentation (who can create service accounts, admin roles)
- MFA and password policy enforcement for admin accounts
- Sample audit log extract for user admin events (timestamped)

Next steps we agreed:
1) We'll kick off the vendor security questionnaire you shared (attached).
2) I will pull the SOC 2 report and IAM docs and share links/attachments by EOD Monday.
3) If you need a technical contact to validate SAML metadata, please loop them in.

Related account: Vitality Health | Deal: RDW-2026-0421

Attachments: vendor_security_questionnaire_vitality.xlsx (please fill and re-send)

If anything above is incorrect or missing, let me know. Otherwise I'll circulate the artifacts and a short attestation for your security team.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0134

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@vitality.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@vitality.health>, security@vitality.health
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: IAM evidence & SOC 2 status — next steps

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap. Quick clarifications: 
- Yes please share the SOC 2 Type II and a short attestation of scope (prod vs non-prod).
- For SSO we need the SAML metadata file and a short guide on SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated flows.
- For SCIM we want the API spec and an indication if you support bulk provisioning and SCIM v2.
- RBAC: a matrix showing roles and permissions would be ideal.

I'm attaching the vendor questionnaire we use. Once you return it, our security team will triage.

Jordan Smith
Director, IT Security | Vitality Health
jordan.smith@vitality.health

Attachment: vendor_security_questionnaire_vitality.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@vitality.health>, Elena Park <elena.park@vitality.health>
Cc: security@vitality.health, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: IAM evidence & SOC 2 status — next steps

Jordan — thanks. See the attached artifacts below; I included the short scope note for SOC 2. Where we can't share raw logs in this thread, I've provided a time-limited S3 link and a contact for a live verification session with our infra team.

Attachments included: 
- SOC2_Type_II_report_2026.pdf (scope: production inference runtime, control environment)
- sso_saml_metadata.xml (SP metadata + ACS URLs)
- scim_api_spec.md (SCIM v2 supported; bulk create/update endpoints documented)
- rbac_admin_controls.pdf (role matrix and admin approval flow)

A couple quick notes:
- We enforce MFA for all admin roles (Okta enforced, can provide proof of policy).
- SCIM supports attribute mapping; we can provide a sample mapping for Vitality during onboarding.
- For audit logs, we can provide a signed CSV extract via a secure link during the live review.

Related links: https://redwood.internal/docs/iam/sso-scim-setup (internal playbook - accessible to your security reviewer during the session)

If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute technical session with our infra lead (Aditya Rao) to walk through SAML metadata and SCIM provisioning. Suggested times: Tue/Wed morning PST.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: SOC2_Type_II_report_2026.pdf; sso_saml_metadata.xml; scim_api_spec.md; rbac_admin_controls.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Need SAML metadata, SCIM endpoints & audit extract for Vitality

Hi Aditya / Dev —

Following up from the Vitality call. Jordan asked for the items below and would like a short live review: 
- Confirm SAML metadata file (SP metadata is attached to the prospect email thread)
- Provide SCIM v2 endpoint base URL, sample bearer token header, and whether bulk operations are supported
- Export a 7-day audit log extract for admin-user events (create/update/delete user, role grants) and place a signed CSV on the secure S3 link (time-limited URL).
- Short note confirming MFA enforced for admin console (policy name in Okta) and how RBAC admin approvals are logged.

Could you send the artifacts and a suggested 30-min slot for a technical walkthrough? Jordan suggested Tue/Wed morning PST.

Thanks — I included the prospect's security contact in the external thread.

Marissa
